catalog.nvfp4Search: A Blackwell GPU na memoriye yuzuye yabonetse. Guhitamo NVFP4 ubwoko igihe imiterere n'umukoresha babishyigikira. Native FLUX.2 Klein 4B Itangira ry'ibikorwa byoroshye riboneka mu nyandiko z'ikoranabuhanga; suzuma CUDA PyTorch, dependencias optional, companion models na memory free mbere yo gufungura. Igaragaza ry'ibikorwa by'ikoranabuhanga ntiryemeza igihe cyo gutangira cyateguwe cyangwa ntiritanga icyizere cy'ubushobozi.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 ni ingirakamaro kugirango iyi GPU na FLUX.2 Klein 4B family. Gufungura native bisaba i Comfy layout, CUDA PyTorch na dependencies optional. Guhitamo ishusho model, Qwen3 encoder na VAE bitandukanye mu Igenamiterere. Igihe cy'ikora, ikombinesheni n'imibare y'imibare ikeneye gusuzumwa.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 yerekanye: Ubushobozi bw'GPU, umigongo ikenewe, ibyerekeye ibitabo cyangwa ubushobozi bw'inyigisho ntibishyinzwe. Reba ikimera cy'CUDA mbere yo guhitamo iyi variant. Icyo gusa ntikomeza ubwumvikane.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Native NVFP4 si byiza na GPU cg VRAM. Niba ushaka kwandika GGUF cg i motori y'ikoranabuhanga, gerageza ukoreshe iyi nzira. Iyi nzira ntitanga acceleration native FP4.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF guidance for text, image and video components: Q6_K or higher is our suggested starting point when prioritizing fidelity; Q4_K_M balances quality and memory. These are recommendations, not a universal accuracy threshold. Results depend on the model and task. NVFP4 and other quantification schemes need their own compatibility and quality assessment.
